warning: These prices are invented for teaching. They are NOT the price list of any real vendor and must never be used for a real budget decision.
how_to_replace: 1. Open the official pricing page of the vendor you actually use and write down the access date in 'as_of'.
2. Copy one entry per real model, keep the same four keys: input_per_mtok, output_per_mtok, cached_input_per_mtok, context_window.
3. Keep the three tier names small, medium, large as aliases (the 'tiers' map) so gateway code and tests do not change; only the model names behind the tiers change.
4. Set 'illustrative' to false only after step 1, and commit the file to your own repo, not to the shared base.
